children.name: Agent Approval Boundary
children.description: Flags agent-controlled paths that reach destructive operations, credentialed APIs, git mutation, package install, deploy, or external requests without approval, consent, or scoped policy evidence.

children.name: Agent Boundary Safety
children.description: Correlates taint-analysis facts with LLM prompt and tool-call boundaries so untrusted or sensitive data cannot quietly cross an agent boundary without typed validation or sanitization.

children.name: Agent Detection
children.description: Recognizes agent configuration files and conventions so Sonde can explain automation posture and repo collaboration context.

children.name: Agent Instruction Health
children.description: Checks shared agent guidance for stale commands, missing GitHub token escalation guidance, and incomplete worktree baseline instructions.

children.name: Agent Loop Safety
children.description: Flags agent orchestration loops that invoke agents recursively or dynamically without explicit iteration, depth, budget, timeout, or termination controls.

children.name: Agent Plugin Install Health
children.description: Checks Sonde MCP setup documentation for a supported install command or .mcp.json path so agent integrations are installable without guesswork.

children.name: Agent Tool Result Trust Boundary
children.description: Flags agent flows where MCP or tool results are promoted into instructions, tool selection, or executable parameters without schema, quoting, allowlist, or non-instruction boundary evidence.

children.name: Prompt Injection Boundary
children.description: Correlates untrusted retrieved text, external documents, and user input with system or tool-selection prompt sinks so missing quote and instruction boundaries become visible.

children.name: Prompt Schema Drift
children.description: Compares prompt-declared action fields with runtime schema facts so agent prompts cannot silently diverge from the TypeChat-style validator that gates execution.

children.name: Sensitive Prompt Egress
children.description: Correlates sensitive labels such as credentials, PHI, PAN, or PII with external model prompt sinks so data egress is not hidden inside agent prompt construction.

children.name: Structured Output Validation
children.description: Requires TypeChat, Zod, JSON Schema, or equivalent validation before structured LLM output can drive tools, writes, commands, or agent actions.

children.name: Unsafe Tool Parameterization
children.description: Flags high-impact agent tools when untrusted parameters reach writes, network calls, or command execution without typed schema validation or sanitization.

racks.name: Database Schema Analysis
racks.description: Database schema analysis surface. Atomic schema-level probes cover missing FK indexes, nullable primary keys, 1NF repeating-column groups, redundant constraints, hot-access zones, graph-database fit, compliance carryover, referential-integrity hazards (missing cascade rules, dangerous CASCADE deletes, orphan-row risk, SET NULL violating NOT NULL), normal-form violations (2NF partial dependency, 3NF transitive dependency, BCNF non-superkey determinant) over a functional-dependency capability, and schema-complexity hazards (wide tables, foreign-key cycles, deep foreign-key chains, polymorphic associations, missing temporal columns, soft-delete inconsistency) over an FK-cycle capability.

children.name: 1NF Repeating Column Group
children.description: Detects numbered sibling columns that encode a denormalized child collection (1NF violation) and recommends splitting into a child table or graph relationship.

children.name: 2NF Partial Dependency
children.description: Flags non-prime attributes that depend on a proper subset of a composite candidate key.

children.name: 3NF Transitive Dependency
children.description: Flags non-prime attributes determined by other non-prime attributes — the classic transitive dependency that 3NF eliminates by extracting the determinant into its own relation.

children.name: BCNF Non-Superkey Determinant
children.description: Flags non-trivial functional dependencies whose determinant is not a superkey.

children.name: Dangerous Cascade
children.description: Detects ON DELETE or ON UPDATE CASCADE rules pointing into compliance- or retention-flagged entities so regulated data is never erased outside its retention contract.

children.name: Deep Foreign Key Chain
children.description: Flags acyclic foreign-key chains whose edge depth exceeds the deep-chain threshold.

children.name: Foreign Key Cycle
children.description: Detects strongly connected components in the foreign-key graph (including self-loops) and surfaces the dbschema.fk-cycles capability for downstream chain and soft-delete probes.

children.name: Functional Dependencies
children.description: Surfaces declared, inferred, and observed functional dependencies so downstream 2NF/3NF/BCNF probes can analyze normalization without re-deriving the FD set.

children.name: Graph Database Recommendation
children.description: Scores how well a relational schema fits a graph database target by weighing recursive joins, many-to-many tables, and traversal-heavy access patterns.

children.name: Missing Cascade Rule
children.description: Flags foreign-key relationships that do not declare ON DELETE or ON UPDATE actions.

children.name: Missing Foreign Key Index
children.description: Flags foreign-key-shaped columns that lack a covering index.

children.name: Missing Temporal Columns
children.description: Flags tables that accept inserts, updates, or deletes but lack created_at or updated_at columns.

children.name: Nullable Primary Key
children.description: Detects primary-key constraints whose member fields are nullable.

children.name: Orphan Row Risk
children.description: Flags RESTRICT or NO ACTION foreign keys whose parent entity accepts hard-delete operations.

children.name: Polymorphic Association
children.description: Detects <base>_id + <base>_type discriminator pairs that hide the real foreign-key edge.

children.name: Redundant Constraint
children.description: Surfaces duplicate constraint or index relationships sharing the same kind, scope, and field set.

children.name: Schema Compliance Carryover
children.description: Surfaces compliance-tagged columns (PII, PHI, financial) in the source schema.

children.name: Schema Hot Zones
children.description: Highlights tables and columns under disproportionate read or write pressure.

children.name: SET NULL Violates NOT NULL
children.description: Detects SET NULL referential actions on foreign-key columns that are themselves NOT NULL.

children.name: Soft Delete Inconsistency
children.description: Flags FK-related entity pairs where one declares deleted_at and the other does not.

children.name: Wide Table
children.description: Flags entities whose field count exceeds the wide-table threshold.
